subject.title: Discord compaction still fails with provider_error_4xx after #90496 closure on 2026.6.5

question: Should Discord/Codex provider-4xx compaction failures automatically rotate or preserve the channel session, or should OpenClaw only surface an actionable recovery path?
rationale: Current code can identify the provider_error_4xx path, but the remaining behavior changes transcript/session continuity and cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep canonical and choose recovery policy
options.body: Keep this issue open, get live Discord/Codex proof, and then implement the selected provider-4xx recovery behavior in the Codex/session boundary.

options.title: Fold into timeout work
options.body: Treat this as covered only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92899 or a successor explicitly proves provider-403 Discord recovery, not just timeout progress reuse.

options.title: Require manual recovery only
options.body: Keep the runtime from automatic rotation and instead improve the user-visible failure text and doctor/support path for Codex auth/provider 4xx failures.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and choose recovery policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, get live Discord/Codex proof, and then implement the selected provider-4xx recovery behavior in the Codex/session boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh owned the merged follow-up that fixed adjacent symptoms and explicitly documented this provider-4xx recovery policy as not covered.
